scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on positive-semidefinite Gram matrices and Hermite–Genocchi divided differences; numerical checks are supplementary, not proof; no priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complex Hilbert space dimension at least three; three equal-overlap rank-one orthogonal projections; 0<t<1; not a higher-cardinality, unequal-overlap, or weighted classification. Classical fixed-moment matrix inequalities may overlap part of the result. Independent scientific validation has not occurred.
title: Bargmann-phase reversal in sharp Schatten envelopes of three equiangular projections
